Why this tool exists

Figma’s Glass effect has no browser equivalent. The usual workarounds lean on backdrop-filter and an SVG displacement map, which only works in Chromium and never matches the original. I rebuilt the effect properly in WebGL2 so the same Depth, Dispersion, Frost and Splay values produce the same result on the web, then made it something you can copy into your own site.
